entries.prompt: Production background for a CASUAL CARTOON TOY STACKING MOBILE GAME. Portrait 9:16 raster. Entire city is a visibly miniature plastic construction toy, like a high quality colorful 3D animated mobile puzzle game. Chunky geometric modern apartment blocks, blue and butter-yellow buildings, coral pink rectangular high-rises, saturated cyan windows, simplified candy-like cornices, tiny rooftop water tanks. Smooth molded plastic material, broad bevels, strong warm ambient shadows, exaggerated cartoon proportions, NO realistic materials, NO medieval architecture, NO Mediterranean village, NO stone texture, NO flowers, NO real photography. Bright cerulean blue sky with large soft balloon-like white clouds. Modern city skyline layers occupy bottom half and both edges; central vertical lane kept spacious for a tower that will be rendered separately. View from GROUND level across a sunny flat city plaza; simple pale warm yellow toy concrete plaza covers the bottom 18 percent edge-to-edge and connects to building sidewalks. The ground horizon under the tower must be unambiguously flat ground. Richly layered city walls to sides rise to 35 percent from top; lower right coral building and lower left yellow building frame scene. Upper 25 percent blue sky with no objects for HUD. Foreground and background silhouettes clean and bold, polished premium casual game art, joyful and vivid, dimensional toy diorama, harmonious blue/yellow palette. The tower and game objects and ground platform are NOT included. NO text, NO logo, NO UI, NO buttons, NO characters, NO faces, NO floating islands, NO border. Finished game environment texture, not a concept board.
